description: This file defines a mock class 'GstWebAudioPlayerMock' for the 'IGstWebAudioPlayer' interface, used for unit testing within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It includes mock methods for audio player controls such as setCaps, play, pause, setVolume, getVolume, writeBuffer, setEos, and getQueuedBytes.
